name: Real Bombchu
description: A bomb that can remain stationary, move in different directions, or be picked up and thrown by the player.

fields.name: Player Number
fields.description: The player assigned to the Bombchu when using mode 5.

fields.name: Reduced Movement Speed
fields.description: When enabled, reduces movement speed in Horizontal (mode 3) and Diagonal (mode 4) modes.

fields.name: Disable Timer
fields.description: When enabled, the Bombchu does not explode automatically and only explodes when damaged.

fields.name: Movement Mode
fields.description: Defines how the Bombchu moves and behaves.

0.name: Inactive (Pickupable)
0.description: Does not move or explode and can be picked up by the player.

1.name: Timed
1.description: Activates and explodes after a delay.

2.name: Timed (Alternate)
2.description: Activates and explodes after a delay. Uses an alternate configuration.

3.name: Horizontal
3.description: Moves horizontally from left to right and explodes after a delay.

4.name: Diagonal
4.description: Moves diagonally and explodes after a delay.

5.name: Player-Held
5.description: Is held by the player and can be thrown.
